findings.title: Triple policy surface drift risk (APPEND_SYSTEM + HARNESS + AGENTS)
findings.detail: Skills policy and tool-execution rules duplicated across HARNESS.md and AGENTS.md; runtime inject is APPEND_SYSTEM.md. last30days 217KB note already shows dual-doc sync cost. No single owner doc marked canonical for conflicts.
findings.recommendation: Canonicalize: APPEND_SYSTEM = runtime triggers only; HARNESS = contract; AGENTS = human git/ops map. Cross-link one line each; avoid copying long policy twice.

findings.detail: 48 skill dirs under skills/. Fat always-candidate bodies (if not denied): writing-great-skills 33499, research 26348, gsd-plan-phase 24618, gsd-execute-phase 24310, gsd-debug 21948, domain-modeling 19358, prompt-sharpen 18790, wayfinder 18634.
